lines.name: Lucien
lines.about: Lucien Flavius is an Imperial follower, first found in Dead Man's Drink in Falkreath, whose two quests take you to the Dwemer ruin of Dumzbthar on Solstheim. The line has two quests, each a single trip into the ruin.

getIn.where: Dead Man's Drink in Falkreath, or wherever he is travelling with you
getIn.how: Take Lucien on as your follower and talk with him about a Dwemer ruin called Dumzbthar; some days later he gets a letter and key from his father and asks you to take him to the ruin on Solstheim.
needs: Lucien Flavius travelling with you, having talked with him about Dumzbthar
Some days passing after that talk

order.what: Lucien's resonant sphere warns that Dumzbthar is under attack; go back and fight the Daedra that came through its Oblivion Gate.
order.where: Dumzbthar and Dumzbthar Core, Solstheim
order.needs: The Oblivion Engine finished, and Lucien travelling with you

order.what: Take Lucien to Dumzbthar, work the switches and valves, and shut down the Daedric intelligence that runs the ruin.
order.where: Dumzbthar, a short walk from Raven Rock on Solstheim

gives: Lucien sets up his laboratory in Dumzbthar, goes back there when dismissed and rejoins you when asked (The Oblivion Engine)
Clive, a horse that travels with Lucien and appears when he needs it (Intruders)

unsure.why: The line's record order puts Intruders first, but Intruders needs The Oblivion Engine done (Lucien has to have brought Dumzbthar back); the story starts with The Oblivion Engine.
The opening line needs a stage of Lucien's follower quest plus two checks the files can't decode, and the wait is kept against days passed; how many days isn't readable.
No level gate is in the records for any quest in this line, so the level it is made for isn't given.
What sets off the resonant sphere for Intruders (time passing, where you are) isn't in the files.

lines.name: Serana
lines.about: These are extra quests for Serana from the Dawnguard story: a search for history books, a romance path with trips to Solitude, Whiterun and Castle Volkihar, and her cure at Falion's in Morthal. The line has seven quests; the last six are taken with Serana travelling with you.

getIn.where: with you if she's following, otherwise Fort Dawnguard or Volkihar Keep
getIn.how: Once you have freed her, Serana asks you to find four books about the events behind the Dragonborn Prophecy and offers you lessons in return; start by asking Urag gro-Shub in the Arcanaeum at the College of Winterhold.
needs: Awakening: free Serana in Dimhollow Crypt

order.what: Find four history books for Serana, starting with Urag gro-Shub in the Arcanaeum, and give them to her.
order.where: The Arcanaeum, College of Winterhold

order.what: Serana asks to feed on your blood while you sleep; find a safe bed, an inn if you can, and rest.
order.where: any inn or safe bed

order.what: Show Serana around Solitude, then take a job from Jarl Elisif to get Torygg's scroll back from a thief at Kilkreath.
order.where: Solitude and Kilkreath Ruins, Haafingar

order.what: Buy potions at Arcadia's Cauldron, find Braith, who has Arcadia's experimental potion, and return the potion to Arcadia.
order.where: Arcadia's Cauldron and the Cloud District, Whiterun
order.needs: Be on Unseen Visions, before reaching the Ancestor Glade

order.what: Tell Serana how you feel, have Fralia Gray-Mane make her a ring, and give it to her in the Castle Volkihar courtyard.
order.where: Fralia Gray-Mane's stall in Whiterun and the Castle Volkihar Courtyard

order.quest: At the Tempo of our Heartbeats
order.what: Ask Serana to dance, apologise the next day, and finish the talk with her in the Castle Volkihar courtyard.
order.where: Castle Volkihar Courtyard

order.what: Follow Serana to Falion in Morthal and watch the ritual that cures her at the summoning circle in the swamp.
order.where: Falion's House and the swamp near Morthal, Hjaalmarch

gives: Serana's Ring, which shields its bearer from poison and disease (From Arena to Oblivion)
Lessons from Serana in skills she's good at (From Arena to Oblivion)
500 septims from Jarl Elisif (Solitude in Company)
Loved, the rested bonus a spouse normally gives (Ambivalence)
Serana's Gold Ruby Necklace: Health regenerates 50% faster (Serana's cure vampirism)
closes: Serana is no longer a vampire once cured (Serana's cure vampirism)

unsure.why: No level gate is in the records for any quest in this line, so the level it is made for isn't given.

The line's record order isn't story order for the romance quests: the romance add-on opens with At the Tempo of our Heartbeats, and Ambivalence's journal looks back to the courtyard talk, so At the Tempo of our Heartbeats likely comes before Ambivalence. The conditions on Serana's romance lines aren't in the files, so how far the romance must have gone for each isn't known.

Whether Serana must be following you for From Arena to Oblivion isn't shown; its script is named after the main quest The Throat of the World, which hints at when it is offered, but no condition says so.
What starts Serana's cure vampirism (what you say to her, or which Dawnguard quest must be done first) isn't in the files.

Which skills Serana's lessons cover isn't readable. Loved comes from the Ambivalence script, not confirmed in play. The necklace comes from Serana Dialogue Expansion and its text ties it to the cure, but the hand-over isn't traced. The Bleeding Flower's two effects, Anemia and Blood Feeding, aren't explained in the files, so they're left out.
The Bleeding Flower fails if you reach Serana's home before sleeping; which place counts as her home isn't stated.
Mirrors of Youth's journal says Braith plans to use the potion on Lars Battle-Born; whether she has drunk any of it isn't stated.

lines.name: Katana and Megara
lines.about: Katana, a follower first met in the Winking Skeever in Solitude, hunts a thief named River with her informant Megara, and their story goes on through inns, bandit hideouts and lighter trips across Skyrim. The line has seven story quests plus Megara's radiant bandit jobs.

getIn.where: The Winking Skeever in Solitude, then wherever she is travelling with you
getIn.how: Recruit Katana; after some time talk to her when you have a moment, and she sends you to wait at a table in the Drunken Huntsman in Whiterun.
needs: Some days passing after recruiting her

order.what: Help Megara steal a carrot from Chillfurrow Farm for her horse, Cappy, then talk it over at the Bannered Mare.
order.where: Chillfurrow Farm and the Bannered Mare, Whiterun

order.quest: Honey Nuts and the Chin of Fate
order.what: Take Katana and Megara on a trip to Solitude, Honningbrew Meadery, Riften and Riverwood.
order.where: Solitude, Honningbrew Meadery, Riften and Riverwood
order.needs: Serenata finished; Katana and Megara with you

order.what: Follow Megara's leads from inn to inn, defeat three bandits for their bounties, and confront the thief River near Fort Fellhammer.
order.where: Inns in Whiterun, Markarth, Riften and Winterhold; Silent Moons Camp, Kolskeggr Mine, Broken Helm Hollow and Kilerth's Rest
order.needs: Katana recruited, and some days passed

order.what: A radiant job: Megara sends you to kill a bandit leader at a hideout she picks, then pays you.
order.where: a bandit hideout Megara picks

order.what: Look after Shale while Katana and Megara plan their wedding, then use their scroll to reach the ceremony.
order.where: a city by day, then the wedding the scroll takes you to
order.needs: The Ravens' Lament finished; Katana and Shale with you

order.what: Go back to Kilerth's Rest with Katana, then spend time with her on the coast by Katla's Farm.
order.where: Kilerth's Rest, Winterhold, and the coast by Katla's Farm, Haafingar
order.needs: Chasing the Current finished; Katana with you

order.what: Take Katana and Megara to the Moorside Inn, then get Al'Tharo's spectacles back from Thalmor spies by Movarth's Lair.
order.where: Moorside Inn and Movarth's Lair, Hjaalmarch

order.what: Go after River with Katana and Megara, starting at the Bee and Barb, and rescue Shale from her.
order.where: The Bee and Barb, Vilemyr Inn and Fallowstone Cave, the Rift
order.needs: Chasing the Current finished; Katana and Megara with you

options: Heed Elli at the Frozen Hearth, who warns you off Fort Fellhammer and offers coins
Go to Fort Fellhammer anyway, and she says you'll be enemies
Follow Katana's guess to Vilemyr Inn
Follow Megara's guess to Fallowstone Cave
A quiet time together by Katla's Farm
Katana getting the better of you

gives: A bounty reward from Megara (Chasing the Current) and gold for her bandit jobs (Megara's Radiant Quests)
closes: River is gone by the end of The Ravens' Lament

unsure.why: No level gate is in the records for any quest in this line, so the level it is made for isn't given.

The line's record order isn't story order. Chasing the Current opens the line; Sugar and Spice and The Ravens' Lament follow it, Serenata follows The Ravens' Lament (where Shale joins), and Honey Nuts and the Chin of Fate follows Serenata ('after dealing with Chadryn'). These links come from journals; no condition in the files ties them. What must happen before Megara offers The Sweetest Carrot, The Khat's Eye or her bandit jobs isn't shown.

Chasing the Current also needs a step of another quest that isn't in the files, and the wait after recruiting Katana is kept against days passed; how many days isn't decoded. Meeting Katana itself has no journal beyond 'Katana recruited.'
Which answer to Elli locks you out, which of the two guesses in The Ravens' Lament is right, and what picks the ending of Sugar and Spice aren't shown.

Tsukikage is named by The Ravens' Lament's script beside a crate set aside for a sword; whether it's handed to you isn't confirmed. The sizes of Megara's bounty reward and job pay aren't in the records. Chasing the Current's last journal only hopes Megara will join you ('Maybe she'd even like to join us'), and The Ravens' Lament says Shale may; later quests need both with you, which is how the joining is read.
The journal says 'River's gone'; whether she dies isn't stated.

lines.name: Fura Bloodmouth
lines.about: Fura Bloodmouth, a vampire of the Volkihar court in Castle Volkihar, has two quests about her past: a visit to her mother in Solitude and a score to settle with an Imperial legate. Both are short, and the second needs you to be a vampire.

getIn.how: Talk to Fura and agree to go with her to Angeline's Aromatics in Solitude to meet her mother.

order.what: Bring Fura to her mother, Angeline Morrard, at Angeline's Aromatics, and decide whether Angeline lives.
order.where: Angeline's Aromatics, Solitude

order.what: Use Vampire's Seduction to send Legate Quentin Cipius from Whiterun to Cold Rock Pass, and witness Fura confront him.
order.where: Whiterun and Cold Rock Pass, Hjaalmarch
order.needs: Be a vampire with the Vampire's Seduction power

options: Let Fura and her mother reunite
Kill Angeline, as a true Volkihar
Let Fura's Death Hounds kill Cipius
Persuade Fura to let Cipius go

closes: Angeline Morrard, who runs Angeline's Aromatics in Solitude, dies if you kill her (Blood Ties)
Legate Quentin Cipius dies if you let the Death Hounds kill him (Bloodmouth)

unsure.why: No level gate is in the records for any quest in this line, so the level it is made for isn't given.

No condition is on Fura's opening line. She lives in Castle Volkihar among the vampire court, so you likely need to be welcome there and have her following you, but that isn't shown; the files don't show how she is recruited.
Blood Ties ends with 'now we will go finish what must be done', which points to Bloodmouth coming next, but no condition ties the two.
Neither quest lists a reward in the records. Bloodmouth's script holds a 'Reanimate Corpse' spell, but by its name it is likely used on Cipius's body rather than given to you.

Cipius's record marks him as someone who can't be killed, while the journal says the Death Hounds kill him; the files don't show how the quest gets round that. Blood Ties also has a failing end and a 'Fura's mother is dead' entry whose trigger isn't shown.
